name: yaps-dictation
description: Voice-type into Codex and desktop apps through Yaps.

interface.shortDescription: Voice-type into Codex and any desktop app.
interface.longDescription: Set up and troubleshoot system-wide Yaps voice typing for Codex and other desktop apps. Yaps desktop supplies microphone capture, local or cloud transcription, cleanup, context-aware vocabulary, the global shortcut, and text insertion; this plugin provides guided setup, readiness checks, and recent-dictation recovery.
defaultPrompt: Set up Yaps voice typing for Codex.
Check why Yaps dictation is not working.
Recover my most recent Yaps dictation.
